title: refactor(driver-sql): the by-path readers read the sql-driver facade, so the codemod moves the five path-reader members (#30147 phase 2c)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWMEECkfNfe2VjW9rMJG3n7)_

Part of #30147 (phase 2c of 2a-2d: the readers that sliced `sql-driver.ts` by path read the facade form, so the codemod moves the five path-reader members. 2d and the phase 3 measurement stay open on the card.)

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:新增 `scripts/sql-driver-split-source.mjs`,把 `SqlDriver` 重新读成一份文本(每个 codemod stub 的方法体换成它所调用的 facet 方法体,leaf 放回类前);cli 的 5 个 generate-* pin 和 `check-keyed-text-bounds.mjs` 改用它。codemod 因此清空 2 个 pin 和 10 个 needle,`createColumn` 写出返回类型 `void`,重新生成后 5 个成员变成委托,登记表 73 → 68。
- 为什么改:这些读者只认 `sql-driver.ts` 本文件的文字,codemod 只好把这 5 个方法留在类上(#30147,裁决 6597555122 第 3 条:读者与模块同一个 PR 里跟上)。
- 风险与回滚:方法体逐字节不变(180/180),公开 `.d.ts` 与 base 相同;5 个 pin 断言一条未改,只换了读取来源。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`sql-driver-split-source.mjs`(约 160 行,只认 codemod 写的 stub 形态,认不出就抛错而不是读 stub);`cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` 与 `turbo.json` 里为 cli 新增的声明。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --self-test`(新电池 "split readers (#30147)" 8 例)和 `node scripts/check-keyed-text-bounds.mjs --self-test`(新增 3 例),都退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位审阅并落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Five members stayed on `SqlDriver` because readers sliced `sql-driver.ts` by path: `createColumn`, `createAuditTimestampColumn`, `varcharColumnChars`, `ensureShardTable` and `initObjects`. Each reader now reads `SqlDriver` as one text, and the codemod tables that held the five go.

**`scripts/sql-driver-split-source.mjs` (new, with its `.d.mts`).** `readSqlDriverSource(srcDir)` returns `sql-driver.ts` with the body of every codemod stub replaced by the body of the facet method it calls, and the leaf (`sql-driver-top-level.ts`) put back ahead of the class. A method's own signature on the class is then followed by its own body, as before the split. It follows exactly the stub the codemod writes: one statement, carrying the `[#29520 codemod]` marker, returning `<X>Facet.<m>(…)` or `<X>Facet.<m>.call(<x>Host.of(this), …)` (or the generic spelling), with the module named in the marker. A marked body of any other shape, a missing module, or a facet without that static member throws. The reader never hands back the stub text. Unmarked bodies (the hand-series delegations) stay as they are. It is a reading, not an undo: imports, a private docblock and the stub-side spellings stay as the split has them. `--verify` remains the byte-for-byte proof.

**Readers.**
- The five `packages/cli` generate-* pins (`builtin-id-column`, `field-type-vocabulary`, `file-reference-width`, `multiple-json-column`, `string-family-width`) build `SQL_DRIVER_SOURCE` from `readSqlDriverSource(DRIVER_SQL_SRC).text` instead of `readFileSync(…/sql-driver.ts)`. No assertion, anchor or message changes.
- `scripts/check-keyed-text-bounds.mjs` reads its emitter the same way. A reader refusal becomes the gate's existing `{ error }` refusal.

**Codemod (`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`).**
- `PATH_READER_PINS` (2 rows) and `PATH_READER_NEEDLES` (10 rows) are emptied. Both tables stay, with a note on why they are empty.
- `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` gains `createColumn: 'void'`, copied from the base `dist/index.d.ts` (`protected createColumn(…): void;`).
- Regenerated from `21510bba`: `createColumn`, `createAuditTimestampColumn` and `varcharColumnChars` move to `sql-driver-column-creation.ts`; `ensureShardTable` and `initObjects` move to `sql-driver-rotation.ts`; two top-level declarations move to the leaf. `sql-driver.ts` goes from 10,624 to 9,741 lines.

**Declarations.** The pins now read every `sql-driver-*.ts` module a stub names, through paths the cross-package scan cannot name. `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` gives `@objectstack/cli` the glob `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-*.ts` plus the reader and its `.d.mts`, with `heldBy` witnesses naming the five pins (and one for `sql-driver.ts`, which no literal names any more). `turbo.json` `@objectstack/cli#test` carries the same three inputs. The glob also matches the package's tests; that adds no re-run, because `cli#test` already depends on `build` → `^build`, and driver-sql's `build` hashes `$TURBO_DEFAULT$`.

**Registry.** The five rows are deleted, so 73 rows become 68 (the base has 73: #30264 added four `engine.ts` rows after 2b's count of 69).

| card | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| #30020 | 19 | 19 |
| #30054 | 16 | 16 |
| #30055 | 6 | 6 |
| #30147 | 32 | 27 (sql-driver.ts 8 → 3) |
| total | 73 | 68 |

The three `sql-driver.ts` rows left on #30147 are `applyFilterCondition` (2d), `get supports` and `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` (phase 3 names both).

## Tests

- Codemod `--self-test` gains a seventh battery, "split readers (#30147)", with 8 cases, driven over a split the script generates and lays out on disk:
  - every stub is followed;
  - each followed stub reads its base body byte for byte after the signature the class keeps;
  - no stub text survives;
  - the leaf stands ahead of the class;
  - an unsplit file is read as it stands;
  - a missing module, a facet without the static, and a marked stub of another shape each refuse.

  106 cases in 7 batteries (98 in 6 before); the battery floor goes 6 → 7.
- `check-keyed-text-bounds --self-test` gains 3 cases in "the emitter-derived family" (floor 3 → 6): the family is read through a stub from the facet module, and a stub naming an undeclared facet or of another shape refuses.
- No assertion in any of the five pins changes. Before the reader change, the regenerated tree reds 28 of their cases and `check-keyed-text-bounds` exits 2 ("could not find the keyed-text arm"). Measured.
- The suites below ran at base `bfca0efb` and at head; the counts are equal.

| suite | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| driver-sql (`vitest run`) | 238 files passed, 12 skipped; 3,859 passed, 216 skipped | the same |
| driver-turso (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 97 files; 2,514 passed, 34 skipped | the same |
| driver-sqlite-wasm (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 40 files; 750 passed | the same |
| cli by-path pins (9 files, the five generate-* pins among them) | 9 files; 116 passed | the same |
| types / metadata / metadata-protocol by-path tests, spec `check-liveness.test` | 53 / 11 / 33 / 74 passed | the same |

## Acceptance notes

- The facade gate script and its self-test are untouched. `check-keyed-text-bounds.mjs` and the cli pins are by-path readers.
- No changeset, as #30139, #30249 and #30306 (`skip-changeset`): no published behaviour or surface changes.

## Verification

Head `d67df0b5`, base `origin/main` `bfca0efb`.

- Determinism: two `--write` runs from the unsplit input give output tree sha256 `0d2ba8a299610def947cd879cee7e7c36aae58aecfca0f8acacc395339f7bf16` both times (input sha256 `2d2ebebd…`), and the tree on disk is unchanged by either.

- Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (which includes `check:test-typecheck`, so the pins' import of the `.d.mts`) exit 0.

Also run: the codemod, `check-keyed-text-bounds`, durability, `check-tenant-chokepoint` and facade gate `--self-test`s, `check:lean-entry-closure`, eslint over the changed files (0 errors), all exit 0.
- Changed lines 2,417 (+1,407 / -1,010), under the 3,000 threshold.
